[LGRA.10.3.5] **A kwarg is named at most once per action.** An action that
names the same kwarg twice, whether language-defined or from its user-declared
namespace ([LGRA.10.3.4]), is a compile error `DS_VALIDATE_DUPLICATE_KWARG`. The
compiler sorts kwargs by name, so a duplicate would leave the artefact
depending on the order the author wrote them in.
